info.name: AWS Fargate Amazon ECS API (Fargate) Clusters #X Amz Target=AmazonEC2ContainerServiceV20141113.DeleteService API

items.docs: Deletes the specified service within a cluster. You can delete a service if you have no running tasks in it and the desired count is zero. If the service uses a load balancer, the load balancer configuration is removed. If the service was created using a Fargate launch type, the tasks are stopped.
